item.title: ABC News: NDIS advocates are pushing for alternatives to group homes
item.description: Disability accommodation support is under federal government review to reduce NDIS costs, advocates say it should also encourage providers to expand the types of housing offered.

item.title: ABC News: Missing Australian human rights activist charged in Vietnam
item.description: Vietnamese authorities charge an Australian man and two other people with planning to carry out terrorist activities, but a pro-democracy group believes the men were abducted in an act of "transnational repression".

item.title: ABC News: Newcastle paints the town red and blue ahead of Knights' grand final
item.description: Homes and businesses across Newcastle have been painted red and blue as the city gets behind the Knights ahead of their first NRL grand final in 25 years.

item.title: ABC News: 'More like January than September' as SA temperature records broken
item.description: More than a dozen places in South Australia have recorded their hottest September day on record.

item.title: ABC News: Court urged to jail Canberra man for life over partner's 'torturous' death
item.description: The court heard Adam Britt, 41, murdered his partner, Tiffany Spence, in an attack that took place over two days to "punish her".

item.title: ABC News: Silver lining for Freo captain after grand final injury nightmare
item.description: Fremantle gets some badly needed good news in the wake of its AFL grand final disaster, confirming captain Alex Pearce will not need surgery.

item.title: ABC News: Grace Tame feared for her life after abuser's posts, court hears
item.description: Abuse survivor Grace Tame has told a Tasmanian court that she feared for her life, following tweets made by the man who sexually abused her as a child.

item.title: ABC News: Getting AI 'drunk' makes it more likely to break rules, research finds
item.description: A study finds AI models are more likely to answer harmful questions or mishandle confidential information when told to act drunk.

item.title: ABC News: Dockers captain to avoid surgery after grand final injury
item.description: Fremantle Dockers captain Alex Pearce will avoid surgery and is expected to return to pre-season training after suffering an Achilles injury in Saturday's dramatic AFL Grand Final loss to Brisbane.

item.title: ABC News: Teen killed in western Vic crash remembered as 'bubbly' and 'bright'
item.description: A 14-year-old who died in a horror collision in western Victoria on Sunday night while returning from a volleyball tournament has been remembered as an "amazing human being".

item.title: ABC News: UK tourist charged after allegedly drowning, bashing pet dog
item.description: A UK citizen on a working holiday visa has been taken into custody after allegedly drowning and beating a pet dog to death.

item.title: ABC News: Cat at centre of concussion waiver saga forced into medical retirement
item.description: Geelong premiership defender Jake Kolodjashnij, who was at the centre of the club's concussion waiver scandal, has medically retired.

item.title: ABC News: Second brick plant no quick fix for WA housing shortage
item.description: Taxpayers are funding the reopening of the Austral factory, which the government hopes will help address the shortage of bricks plaguing the construction industry.
